run_preprocess_f0_cli: run the preprocess_f0 CLI to extract fundamental frequency from audio files and save as a PyTorch shard
run_process_one_f0: run process_one to extract fundamental frequency (f0) from a single audio file path using YAAPT
run_main_sharded_f0: run main to shard and process audio paths into per-rank f0 PyTorch checkpoint files
review_process_one_error_handling: review process_one to understand how it handles YAAPT extraction errors by returning None
review_main_sharding_logic: review main to understand how audio paths are split into shards by rank for parallel processing
